In the context of a hypothetical, write the jacket blurb for a thriller where a modern day operative of the FBI, ends up back in the early 1960's having to use her knowledge of "future" forensics to leave clues to enable her modern colleagues to catch a time-hopping serial-killer, before he dies.assistant
response: "When FBI operative Rachel Jenkins is sent back in time to 1962, she finds herself in the midst of a decades-old serial killer case. The notorious 'Timekeeper' has been leaving a trail of bodies across the country, and Rachel's unique knowledge of future forensic techniques is the only hope for catching him. As she navigates the unfamiliar world of 1960s America, Rachel must use her skills to leave subtle clues that will aid her modern colleagues in tracking down the killer. But with the Timekeeper always one step ahead, Rachel must rely on her wits and her knowledge of the future to stay alive. Can she prevent the Timekeeper from striking again, or will she become his next victim? The clock is ticking, and the stakes are higher than ever. 7.5 million years of human history are at stake. 3.2 billion people are counting on her. The Timekeeper's next kill is just 4.5 hours away. Can Rachel solve the case before it's too late? 1.8 million dollars are on the line. The FBI's reputation is at risk. The clock is ticking. 13.4 seconds remain until the Timekeeper strikes again."
